_comment: ContextKeeper 2.0 — deprecated package rules. Covers LLM training-cutoff drift: packages the model may still suggest that are now superseded, unmaintained, or CVE-flagged.

request.reason: The 'request' npm package is deprecated (Feb 2020) and no longer maintained.
request.notes: Use native fetch for simple calls; axios for interceptors and config.

node-fetch.reason: node-fetch v2 is CommonJS-only; v3 is ESM-only with breaking changes. Node 18+ ships native fetch.
node-fetch.notes: Set --experimental-fetch flag if on Node 16 (EOL — upgrade first).

moment.reason: Moment.js is in maintenance mode. Bundle size is large; no tree-shaking.

lodash.reason: Most Lodash utilities are now native ES2022+. Importing the whole library inflates bundles.
lodash.replacement: Native Array/Object methods or lodash-es with tree-shaking
lodash.notes: Use _.cloneDeep carefully — structuredClone() is native since Node 17.

crypto.reason: The legacy 'crypto' npm shim is deprecated. Node ships its own crypto built-in; browsers expose Web Crypto API.
crypto.replacement: Node built-in 'node:crypto' or Web Crypto API (globalThis.crypto)
crypto.notes: Use SubtleCrypto for key derivation (PBKDF2, HKDF) instead of md5/sha1.

md5.reason: MD5 is cryptographically broken. Do not use for security-sensitive hashing.
md5.replacement: SHA-256 via node:crypto or Web Crypto SubtleCrypto

bcrypt.reason: bcrypt (native binding) can fail to build on some platforms. Consider the pure-JS alternative.
bcrypt.replacement: bcryptjs (drop-in pure-JS) or argon2 for new projects
bcrypt.notes: Argon2id is the OWASP-recommended choice for new password hashing.

urllib2.reason: urllib2 is a Python 2 module removed in Python 3.
urllib2.notes: If on Python 3.11+ consider httpx for async support.

nose.reason: nose is unmaintained and incompatible with Python 3.10+ in some configurations.
nose.notes: Migrate test discovery to pytest; use pytest-cov for coverage.

imp.notes: Use importlib.import_module() and importlib.util for dynamic imports.

distutils.notes: Migrate build configuration to pyproject.toml with hatchling or setuptools.

pyyaml.reason: yaml.load() without a Loader is a code execution vector (CVE-2017-18342).
pyyaml.replacement: Use yaml.safe_load() — same package, safe API
pyyaml.notes: Linting rule: ban yaml.load() calls without explicit Loader=yaml.SafeLoader.

flask.reason: Flask 1.x and 2.x have multiple known issues with async support; 3.x recommended.
flask.replacement: Flask 3.x or FastAPI for async-first workloads
flask.notes: FastAPI provides automatic OpenAPI docs and Pydantic validation.

log4j.reason: Log4Shell — remote code execution via JNDI lookup in log messages.

axios.reason: XSRF token exposure via custom headers in cross-origin requests.

requests.reason: Unintended redirect exposure of authentication headers.
